mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have lovely clear skies and a temperature of 72 degrees at the Military Ridge State Trail.

The City of Verona Department of Public Works is recruiting an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects like street rehabilitation and utility construction. Applications are open until September 20, 2026.
We have a busy day! Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and young athletes can attend the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
In our weekly police report, on Friday, August 15, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after finding her vehicle stopped near North Main Street.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Caramel Cashew. Additionally, you can grab a Kona Ice today at Fireman's Park until 5 PM or at the Verona Youth Football game until 7:30 PM.
